errors.evidence: The description frames the data as answers to a specific question that is not explicitly written on the chart. The chart caption is "Auswirkungen der Ukrainekrise nach Betriebsgruppen" (Effects of the Ukraine crisis by company groups), so while the inferred question is plausible, it is still an interpretation.

errors.text_span: Jede Antwortkategorie ist durch zwei nebeneinanderliegende Balken dargestellt
errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows three bars, not two, for each category on the y-axis, as indicated by the three items in the legend.

errors.text_span: Der Balken für „überwiegend negativ“ ist für alle drei Gruppen am längsten
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. For the third group ('übrige Betriebe', light blue bar), the longest bar corresponds to 'keine Auswirkungen' (approx. 43%), which is slightly longer than the bar for 'überwiegend negativ' (approx. 42%).
The light blue bar for the 'überwiegend negativ' category is at approximately 42%, not 45%. The value is visibly below the midpoint between 40 and 50.
The value for the third group ('übrige Betriebe', light blue bar) in the 'keine Auswirkungen' category is approximately 43%, not 38%. The bar clearly extends beyond the 40% mark.
The description fails to mention the asterisks (*) next to the labels 'überwiegend negativ', 'keine Auswirkungen', and 'überwiegend positiv' on the y-axis.
